periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the visible eye patches is oriented diagonally at approximately 60-70 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a vertical elongation, showing a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.8:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering is observed, with the lowest point of the patch being narrower than the upper boundary.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior edge of the band exhibits a wide, flat U-shape curvature as it transitions to the white torso fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark transverse band accounts for approximately 30-35% of the total visible lateral torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a wide cranial gap approximately equal to the horizontal width of one ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Top boundaries of the pinnae are smoothly rounded and semicircular.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible brownish-yellow discoloration on the posterior dorsal and flank fur regions relative to the white anterior fur.
